build_convert_input_files: convert input files from paths or FilePayload objects into an InputFilesList for Playwright file uploads
build_resolve_paths_and_directory: resolve a sequence of file paths and directories into local paths and an optional directory stream
build_list_files: list all files recursively in a given directory using os.walk
test_convert_input_files: test convert_input_files with a sequence of string file paths and a BrowserContext
test_resolve_paths_and_directory: test resolve_paths_and_directory with mixed file and directory paths to verify error handling
